grammar.zh: 食品行业在两年中都占据了用水量的最大份额。
grammar.hint: the food industry / account for / the largest share
grammar.en: The food industry accounted for the largest share of water use in both years.
grammar.why: 行业名特指时加 the；最高级前必须加 the。

grammar.zh: 政府应该投资公共交通。
grammar.hint: the government / invest in / public transport
grammar.en: The government should invest in public transport.
grammar.why: 特指政府用 the；泛指一类交通方式用零冠词。

grammar.zh: 一项最新调查显示，多数学生睡眠不足。
grammar.hint: a recent survey / the majority of
grammar.en: A recent survey shows that the majority of students do not get enough sleep.
grammar.why: 首次提及用 a；the majority of 是固定搭配。

grammar.zh: 环境污染是当今最严峻的挑战之一。
grammar.hint: one of the most serious challenges
grammar.en: Environmental pollution is one of the most serious challenges of our time.
grammar.why: one of the + 最高级 + 复数名词。

grammar.zh: 在教室里使用手机常被认为是不礼貌的。
grammar.en: Using mobile phones in the classroom is often considered impolite.
grammar.why: 动名词短语作主语；in the classroom 指特定场所。

grammar.zh: 越来越多的人选择在网上购物。
grammar.hint: an increasing number of / shop online
grammar.en: An increasing number of people choose to shop online.
grammar.why: an increasing number of + 复数名词，谓语用复数。

grammar.zh: 他在大学期间主修经济学。
grammar.en: He majored in economics at university.
grammar.why: 学科名前零冠词；at university 是固定搭配。

grammar.zh: 这项政策对低收入家庭影响最大。
grammar.en: The policy has the greatest impact on low-income families.
grammar.why: 最高级前用 the；复数泛指用零冠词。

grammar.zh: 每个学生都必须完成一份报告。
grammar.hint: each of the students / be required to
grammar.en: Each of the students is required to complete a report.
grammar.why: each of + 复数名词，谓语用单数。

grammar.zh: 政府和公司都在采取措施。
grammar.en: Both the government and companies are taking measures.
grammar.why: both ... and ... 连接的主语，谓语用复数。

grammar.zh: 不是学生，而是老师应该为此负责。
grammar.en: Not the students but the teacher is responsible for it.
grammar.why: not ... but ... 遵循就近原则，看 but 后面的主语。

grammar.zh: 大量塑料垃圾被倒入海洋。
grammar.hint: a large amount of / be dumped into
grammar.en: A large amount of plastic waste is dumped into the ocean.
grammar.why: a large amount of + 不可数名词，谓语用单数。

grammar.zh: 统计数据表明，犯罪率正在下降。
grammar.en: The statistics show that the crime rate is declining.
grammar.why: statistics 表示数据时作复数，谓语用 show。

grammar.zh: 我们每个人都能为环保做出贡献。
grammar.en: Each of us can contribute to environmental protection.
grammar.why: each of us 视为单数，情态动词后用原形。

grammar.zh: 过去十年，城市人口翻了一番。
grammar.en: Over the past decade, the urban population has doubled.
grammar.why: over the past decade 表示持续到现在，用现在完成时。

grammar.zh: 到 2030 年，一半人口将居住在城市。
grammar.en: By 2030, half of the population will be living in cities.
grammar.why: by + 将来时间点，用将来完成或将来进行时。

grammar.zh: 我学英语已经五年了。
grammar.en: I have been learning English for five years.
grammar.why: for + 时间段且动作仍在持续，用现在完成进行时。

grammar.zh: 上次考试我没考好，因为准备不足。
grammar.en: I did not do well in the last exam because of inadequate preparation.
grammar.why: last exam 是明确的过去时间，用一般过去时。

grammar.zh: 政府自 2010 年起就在推广电动车。
grammar.en: The government has been promoting electric vehicles since 2010.
grammar.why: since + 过去时间点，动作延续至今，用现在完成进行时。

grammar.zh: 如果明天下雨，比赛就取消。
grammar.en: If it rains tomorrow, the match will be cancelled.
grammar.why: 主将从现：条件句用一般现在时。

grammar.zh: 等我到达时，会议已经开始了。
grammar.en: By the time I arrived, the meeting had already begun.
grammar.why: 过去某点之前完成的动作，用过去完成时。

grammar.zh: 越来越多的人开始意识到这个问题。
grammar.en: More and more people have come to realize the problem.
grammar.why: 已经发生并影响现在，用现在完成时。

grammar.zh: 每年有数百万棵树被砍伐。
grammar.en: Millions of trees are cut down every year.
grammar.why: 被动语态 be + 过去分词，every year 用一般现在时。

grammar.zh: 这项研究是由一组科学家完成的。
grammar.en: The study was conducted by a group of scientists.
grammar.why: 被动 + by 引出施动者。

grammar.zh: 应该采取更多措施来减少污染。
grammar.en: More measures should be taken to reduce pollution.
grammar.why: 情态动词的被动是 should be done。

grammar.zh: 据说这座桥建于 19 世纪。
grammar.hint: It is said that / be built
grammar.en: It is said that the bridge was built in the 19th century.
grammar.why: It is said that 句型，后接被动。

grammar.zh: 这个问题正被广泛讨论。
grammar.en: The issue is being widely discussed.
grammar.why: 进行时的被动是 is being done。

grammar.zh: 孩子们应该被鼓励独立思考。
grammar.en: Children should be encouraged to think independently.
grammar.why: 被动 + 不定式，encourage sb to do 变被动后 to 保留。

grammar.zh: 今年的销量是去年的两倍。
grammar.en: This year's sales are twice as high as last year's.
grammar.why: 倍数 + as + 形容词 + as 是标准结构。

grammar.zh: 城市人口比农村人口多得多。
grammar.en: The urban population is far larger than the rural population.
grammar.why: far 修饰比较级，表示差距大。

grammar.zh: 房价越高，年轻人越难买房。
grammar.en: The higher house prices rise, the harder it becomes for young people to buy.
grammar.why: the + 比较级，the + 比较级，表示联动变化。

grammar.zh: 与 2000 年相比，贫困率下降了一半。
grammar.en: Compared with 2000, the poverty rate has halved.
grammar.why: compared with 作分词状语；halve 表示减半。

grammar.zh: 这个班的学生人数是那个班的三倍。
grammar.en: There are three times as many students in this class as in that one.
grammar.why: 可数名词用 as many as，倍数放在最前面。

grammar.zh: 越来越多的人选择步行而不是开车。
grammar.en: More and more people choose to walk rather than drive.
grammar.why: rather than 连接两个平行的动词原形。

grammar.zh: 收入差距正在扩大。
grammar.en: The income gap is widening.
grammar.why: 进行时表示正在发生的趋势。

grammar.zh: 服务业是经济中增长最快的部分。
grammar.en: The service sector is the fastest-growing part of the economy.
grammar.why: 复合形容词 fastest-growing 作定语。

grammar.zh: 我认为政府应该禁止在公共场所吸烟。
grammar.en: I believe that the government should ban smoking in public places.
grammar.why: that 引导宾语从句，that 可省略但不影响结构。

grammar.zh: 这就是为什么许多人选择住在大城市。
grammar.en: That is why many people choose to live in big cities.
grammar.why: That is why 后接结果，That is because 后接原因。

grammar.zh: 虽然他很努力，但还是失败了。
grammar.en: Although he worked hard, he still failed.
grammar.why: although 不能与 but 连用，主句用 still 呼应。

grammar.zh: 那些不锻炼的人更容易生病。
grammar.en: Those who do not exercise are more likely to fall ill.
grammar.why: those who 引导定语从句，谓语用复数。

grammar.zh: 原因在于人们缺乏环保意识。
grammar.en: The reason is that people lack environmental awareness.
grammar.why: The reason is that，不用 because。

grammar.zh: 无论发生什么，我们都应该保持冷静。
grammar.en: Whatever happens, we should stay calm.
grammar.why: whatever 引导让步状语从句，本身作主语。

grammar.zh: 这项研究证明，睡眠不足会影响记忆力。
grammar.hint: The study shows that / lack of sleep
grammar.en: The study shows that lack of sleep affects memory.
grammar.why: 宾语从句；主语是 lack of sleep，谓语用单数。

grammar.zh: 只有政府和企业合作，问题才能解决。
grammar.en: Only when the government and businesses cooperate can the problem be solved.
grammar.why: Only + 状语从句置于句首，主句部分倒装。

grammar.zh: 考虑到成本，这个方案不可行。
grammar.en: Given the cost, this plan is not feasible.
grammar.why: Given 是过去分词状语，表示考虑到。

grammar.zh: 为了解决交通拥堵，政府修建了地铁。
grammar.en: To solve traffic congestion, the government built a subway.
grammar.why: 不定式置于句首表示目的。

grammar.zh: 与城市相比，农村地区的机会更少。
grammar.en: Compared with cities, rural areas offer fewer opportunities.
grammar.why: 过去分词状语，逻辑主语是 rural areas。

grammar.zh: 看到这个结果，我很惊讶。
grammar.en: Seeing the result, I was surprised.
grammar.why: 现在分词作状语，逻辑主语须与主句一致。

grammar.zh: 这个问题值得讨论。
grammar.en: The issue is worth discussing.
grammar.why: be worth doing，worth 后接动名词。

grammar.zh: 他建议推迟会议。
grammar.en: He suggested postponing the meeting.
grammar.why: suggest doing sth，不接不定式。

grammar.zh: 被邀请参加典礼的人不多。
grammar.en: Few people were invited to the ceremony.
grammar.why: 被动 + few 表示否定数量。

grammar.zh: 我们需要更多时间来完成任务。
grammar.en: We need more time to complete the task.
grammar.why: 不定式作后置定语修饰 time。

grammar.zh: 这项政策对经济产生了深远影响。
grammar.en: The policy has had a profound impact on the economy.
grammar.why: impact on 是固定搭配；现在完成时强调影响延续至今。

grammar.zh: 他因作弊而受到处罚。
grammar.en: He was punished for cheating.
grammar.why: punish sb for doing sth，介词后接动名词。

grammar.zh: 我们应该重视心理健康。
grammar.en: We should attach importance to mental health.
grammar.why: attach importance to 中的 to 是介词。

grammar.zh: 许多人依赖社交媒体获取新闻。
grammar.en: Many people rely on social media for news.
grammar.why: rely on sb for sth 两个介词各司其职。

grammar.zh: 这个问题的根源在于教育资源分配不均。
grammar.en: The root of the problem lies in the unequal distribution of educational resources.
grammar.why: lie in 表示在于，后接名词性成分。

grammar.zh: 人们越来越关注食品安全。
grammar.en: People are increasingly concerned about food safety.
grammar.why: be concerned about 表示关心、担忧。

grammar.zh: 这次疫情对旅游业造成了巨大损失。
grammar.en: The pandemic caused great damage to the tourism industry.
grammar.why: cause damage to 是固定搭配。

grammar.zh: 他没有意识到问题的严重性。
grammar.en: He was not aware of the seriousness of the problem.
grammar.why: be aware of 后接名词；否定用 not aware of。

grammar.zh: 折线图展示了 2010 至 2040 年法国五类媒体广告支出的预测变化。
grammar.hint: be projected to / advertising spending / across five media
grammar.en: The line graph shows the projected changes in advertising spending across five media in France from 2010 to 2040.
grammar.why: 你写的是 The graphs shows：主语单数要用 shows；costs on advertising 是中式搭配，应为 spending on advertising。

grammar.zh: 2010 年，电视的广告支出最高，占总额的 35% 以上。
grammar.hint: account for / the largest share / over 35% of the total
grammar.en: In 2010, television accounted for the largest share of advertising spending, at over 35% of the total.
grammar.why: 你写了 because of its popularity——Task 1 不解释原因，图表没给就不许写；另外 of all 要写成 of the total。

grammar.zh: 报纸位居第二，接近 35%。
grammar.en: Newspapers came second, at nearly 35%.
grammar.why: 你写 The newspapers is next largest proportion near of all——一句话里没有成立的谓语；排名用 come second / rank second。

grammar.zh: 相比之下，互联网最低，不足 5%。
grammar.hint: by contrast / record the lowest figure / under
grammar.en: By contrast, the Internet recorded the lowest figure, at under 5%.
grammar.why: 不能写 since not every family can possess a computer——这是推测原因；且 no every family 应为 not every family。

grammar.zh: 然而，两者的趋势与过去不同。
grammar.hint: differ from / those of the past
grammar.en: However, their trends differ from those of the past.
grammar.why: the trending of them are 主谓不一致，trending 也不是名词；比较对象要用 those of the past。

grammar.zh: 预计到 2040 年，互联网的广告支出将飙升至 45% 以上。
grammar.en: By 2040, spending on Internet advertising is projected to surge to over 45%.
grammar.why: the cost spend on 应为 spending on；图表预测用 be projected to，不要用 will rapidly surge 这种口语搭配。

grammar.zh: 这主要是因为互联网的繁荣，它影响了所有类型的媒体。
grammar.en: This is mainly because of the boom of the Internet, which has affected all types of media.
grammar.why: because 接从句、because of 接名词；effect 是名词，动词是 affect；media 本身就是复数。

grammar.zh: 尽管电视在 2010 至 2020 年间有所增长，但未来不可避免地会缓慢下降。
grammar.hint: although / inevitably decline / in the future
grammar.en: Although television grew between 2010 and 2020, it will inevitably decline slowly in the future.
grammar.why: there are unavoidable slow downward 里 downward 是形容词，不能当名词；下降要用动词 decline。

grammar.zh: 随着互联网的蓬勃发展，传统媒体尤其是纸媒受到的冲击最大。
grammar.hint: with / have been the most affected
grammar.en: With the booming development of the Internet, traditional media, especially print media, have been the most affected.
grammar.why: media 作主语视为复数，用 have；has been 与复数主语不搭。

grammar.zh: 报纸和杂志的支出将在未来三十年下降。
grammar.en: Spending on newspapers and magazines will decline over the next three decades.
grammar.why: will down 缺动词，down 不能作谓语；三十年用 over the next three decades。

grammar.zh: 广播已经只占很小比例，还将继续下降到 5%。
grammar.en: Radio already accounts for a small proportion and will continue to fall to 5%.
grammar.why: The number of radio channels that already account 里主语是 number，谓语要用 accounts；直接以 radio 作主语更简洁。

grammar.zh: 你想在结尾写「这组数据见证了时代趋势，也指出了实现最大收益的最有效方式」——Task 1 不能这么写。把它改成一句客观的总体判断。
grammar.en: Overall, the figures reflect a clear shift in advertising spending from traditional media to the Internet.
grammar.why: Task 1 不写 In conclusion、不写建议、不预测收益；宏观判断并进 Overview，写完数据就收。

grammar.zh: 该图展示了 1998 至 2008 年法国、德国和英国在食品与其他商品上的收入占比。
grammar.en: The chart illustrates the proportion of income spent on food and other goods in France, Germany and the UK between 1998 and 2008.
grammar.why: between 1998 to 2008 应为 between ... and；including 在这里也不对，国家是范围不是举例。

grammar.zh: 1998 年，法国的食品支出约占 15%，到 2008 年飙升至 40%。
grammar.en: In 1998, France spent about 15% of its income on food, and this figure soared to 40% by 2008.
grammar.why: amounted for 应为 accounted for；soured（变酸）是拼写错误，你要写的是 soared；年份也不能抄错。

grammar.zh: 德国和英国的涨幅较小，分别为 30% 和 15%，都低于法国。
grammar.hint: see smaller increases / respectively / below France's figure
grammar.en: Germany and the UK saw smaller increases, to 30% and 15% respectively, both below France's figure.
grammar.why: had small increase 缺冠词；behind the proportion of France 是中式，用 below France's figure。

grammar.zh: 法国在其他商品上的支出从 1998 年的 10% 上升到 2008 年的 40%。
grammar.en: France's spending on other goods rose from 10% in 1998 to 40% in 2008.
grammar.why: 你把 1998 写成了 2018——Task 1 抄错年份是硬伤；which amounted for 10% ... climbing 这种结构也不成立。

grammar.zh: 英国的比例也从 10% 升到 30% 以上，而德国稳定在 20% 左右。
grammar.en: The figure for the UK also rose from 10% to over 30%, while Germany remained stable at around 20%.
grammar.why: kept the stable trend 应为 remained stable；句首用 But 在学术写作里不合适，用 while 连接。

grammar.zh: 总体而言，十年间食品与其他商品的支出都在上升。
grammar.en: Overall, spending on both food and other goods increased over the ten-year period.
grammar.why: In gernal 拼写错误；有明确过去时间段（1998–2008）时用一般过去时，不用 have increased。

grammar.zh: 这两个饼图展示了 1997 和 2007 年悉尼不同部门的用水比例。
grammar.en: The pie charts illustrate the proportions of water use across different sectors in Sydney in 1997 and 2007.
grammar.why: diving to different sectors 应为 divided among / across；proportion 指多个比例时用复数。

grammar.zh: 总体而言，食品行业在两年中都占据主导地位。
grammar.hint: hold a dominant position / in both years
grammar.en: Overall, the food industry held a dominant position in both years.
grammar.why: Food industry took dominant position 缺两个冠词：the food industry、a dominant position。

grammar.zh: 相比之下，建筑行业和制造业从 1997 到 2007 年都在下降。
grammar.en: In contrast, the building industry and manufacturing both declined between 1997 and 2007.
grammar.why: 行业名前要加 the；between 1997 to 2007 应为 between ... and。

grammar.zh: 此外，建筑行业在五个部门中占比最小。
grammar.hint: account for / the smallest share / among
grammar.en: In addition, the building industry accounted for the smallest share among the five sectors.
grammar.why: took the least level of shares 是中式；三者以上用 among，不是 between。

grammar.zh: 1997 年，食品行业占用水总量的最大份额，达 48%。
grammar.hint: account for / the largest share / at 48%
grammar.en: In 1997, the food industry accounted for the largest share of total water use, at 48%.
grammar.why: took largest peopotion 既有拼写错误又缺冠词；占比用 account for，数字前用 at。

grammar.zh: 第二大的是家庭用水，占 19%。
grammar.en: The second largest was household use, at 19%.
grammar.why: The second part came to 19%, was Household use 用逗号连接两个谓语，句子不成立；直接用 the second largest 作主语。

grammar.zh: 服务业与制造业比例相近，分别为 13% 和 15%。
grammar.en: The service industry and manufacturing showed a similar pattern, at 13% and 15% respectively.
grammar.why: 描述 1997 年要用过去时 showed；respectively 的两个数字必须和前面的两个主体同序。

grammar.zh: 建筑行业占比小得多，两年都没有超过 5%。
grammar.hint: play a smaller role / in neither year
grammar.en: The building industry played a much smaller role, exceeding 5% in neither year.
grammar.why: with neither of them 指代不清——这里只有一个行业；用 in neither year。

grammar.zh: 家庭用水仅以 21% 紧随其后。
grammar.en: Household use followed closely behind at 21%.
grammar.why: Household use merely behind it 缺谓语，behind 不能单独作谓语，要用 followed。

grammar.zh: 该表展示了 2012 年某镇俱乐部成员与公众对一座新剧院的评价。
grammar.en: The table shows how club members and the general public rated a new theatre in one town in 2012.
grammar.why: received that the Quality was excellent 里 received 不能表示「认为」；评价用 rated，且 quality 不需要大写。

grammar.zh: 88% 的俱乐部成员认为质量「优秀」。
grammar.en: 88% of club members rated the quality as excellent.
grammar.why: 百分比作主语时，谓语与 of 后面的名词一致（members → rated）。

grammar.zh: 然而，公众中认为「优秀」的仅占 53%。
grammar.en: However, only 53% of the general public gave an excellent rating.
grammar.why: general public think it excellent is merely 53% 一句话里塞了两个谓语；用名词短语 the proportion / 53% of 作主语。

grammar.zh: 在设施方面，两组中「满意」的比例都在 25% 左右。
grammar.en: As for facilities, the proportion of satisfied responses was around 25% in both groups.
grammar.why: About information 应为 As for；has closed 应为 were close to / around。

grammar.zh: 公众对「差」的评价比例高于俱乐部成员。
grammar.en: The proportion of poor ratings was higher among the general public than among club members.
grammar.why: The public consider excellent is higher than club number consider 两个谓语叠在一起；比较要用同级结构，且比例与人要分清。

grammar.zh: 与设施和质量相比，「信息」一项的评价最差。
grammar.en: Information was the weakest-rated aspect, compared with facilities and quality.
grammar.why: The poportion of poor is higher than facilities and quality 拿「比例」和「项目」比，比较对象不一致。

task1.title: 折线图 · 法国广告支出
task1.zh: 折线图：2010–2040 年法国五类媒体的广告支出预测。写引言段，改写题目，不照抄原题。
slots: 用 illustrate + projected changes 改写
交代五类媒体、地点、时间跨度
task1.ref: The line graph illustrates the projected changes in advertising spending across five media in France between 2010 and 2040.
task1.why: 你原句 The graphs shows ... which reflects the ups and downs ... in the era：主谓错、从句多余、in the era 空泛。引言只做一件事——改写题目。

task1.title: 折线图 · 两条相反趋势
task1.zh: 同一张图：电视、报纸、杂志、广播预计下降，互联网从不足 5% 升到 45% 以上。写概述段。
slots: 用 while 对比两条相反趋势
task1.ref: Overall, while spending on traditional media such as television and newspapers is expected to decline, the figure for the Internet is projected to surge.
task1.why: Overview 只写「谁升谁降、谁最大」，数字留给主体段；更不能写 because of its popularity。

task1.title: 折线图 · 互联网
task1.zh: 互联网 2010 年不足 5%，之后持续增长，2040 年预计超过 45%，成为第一。
slots: 起点 + 变化动词 + 终点
用 surpass / overtake 写超越
task1.ref: The most striking growth was seen in the Internet. Starting at under 5% in 2010, it grew steadily and is projected to surpass television by 2040, reaching over 45%.
task1.why: 你写 the cost spend on the Internet will rapidly surge：spend 应为 spending；上升组必须给起点和终点，不能只说 surge。

task1.title: 折线图 · 电视与广播
task1.zh: 电视 2010 年约 35%，2010–2020 略增，之后缓慢下降；广播已经很小，还将降到 5%。
slots: 先升后降用 before 连接
两个主体用一句对比带过
task1.ref: In stark contrast, television, which started at around 35%, grew slightly until 2020 before entering a slow decline. Radio, already a minor category, is expected to fall further to 5%.
task1.why: 你写 there are unavoidable slow downward：downward 是形容词，不能作名词；用 enter a decline / fall further。

task1.kind: 动态图 · 波动与平稳
task1.title: 柱状图 · 收入占比
task1.zh: 法国食品支出 1998 年 15% → 2008 年 40%；其他商品 10% → 40%；德国稳定在 20% 附近。
task1.ref: France's food spending climbed from 15% in 1998 to 40% in 2008, while its spending on other goods rose from 10% to 40%. Germany, by contrast, remained stable at around 20%.
task1.why: 你把 1998 写成 2018、把 soared 拼成 soured——Task 1 抄错年份和拼写是硬伤。

task1.title: 饼图 · 1997 年用水
task1.zh: 1997 年：食品 48%、家庭 19%、制造 15%、服务 13%、建筑 5%。按「主导组 / 其余组」写两句。
slots: 第二句用 respectively 写后三名
task1.ref: In 1997, the food industry dominated, accounting for 48% of total water use, followed by household use at 19%. Manufacturing and the service industry accounted for 15% and 13% respectively, while the building industry took only 5%.
task1.why: 你按 1997 / 2007 分段，把趋势切断了；静态图按大小分组，动态图才按时间。

task1.kind: 静态图 · 排名与倍数
task1.title: 饼图 · 2007 年用水
task1.zh: 2007 年：食品 41%、服务 25%、家庭 21%、制造 11%、建筑 2%。写排名与倍数。
slots: 用 overtake 写服务超过家庭
用倍数压缩最小的两个
task1.ref: By 2007, the food industry remained dominant at 41%, although the service industry had overtaken household use to become the second largest at 25%. Manufacturing fell to 11%, and the building industry's share was less than a fifth of the service sector's.
task1.why: overtook the place of 是中式，overtake 直接带宾语；结尾用倍数把 2% 和 25% 挂钩，比单独报数有力。

task1.kind: 表格 · 主语与最高分
task1.title: 表格 · 剧院评价
task1.zh: 表格：俱乐部成员 88% 认为质量优秀，公众 53%。写第一句，主语必须是「人的比例」。
task1.ref: The proportion of club members who rated the quality as excellent stood at 88%, compared with 53% of the general public.
task1.why: 你写 Club members received that the Quality was excellent, accounting for 88%：received 不能表示「认为」，主语也不该是人。

task1.title: 表格 · 设施与差评
task1.zh: 设施一项两组「满意」都在 25% 左右；「差」的评价公众高于成员。
slots: 用 as for 切换维度
task1.ref: As for facilities, around 25% of both groups were merely satisfied. The proportion of poor ratings, however, was higher among the general public than among club members.
task1.why: About information 应为 As for；has closed 应为 were close to / around。

task1.kind: 任务回应 · 结尾禁忌
task1.title: 改写 · 删掉不该写的那句
task1.zh: 改写这句，并去掉 Task 1 不该有的内容：「这组数据见证了时代趋势，也指出了实现最大收益的最有效方式。」
slots: 改成一句客观的总体判断
task1.ref: Overall, the figures reflect a clear shift in advertising spending from traditional media to the Internet.
task1.why: Task 1 不写 In conclusion、不写建议、不预测收益；宏观判断并进 Overview，全文到此为止。

task1.title: 流程图 · 巧克力制作
task1.zh: 可可豆采摘 → 发酵 → 烘干 → 烘焙 → 研磨 → 与糖混合 → 入模成型。
task1.ref: First, cocoa pods are harvested by hand and the beans are left to ferment for up to a week. They are then dried in the sun, roasted and ground into a paste. Finally, the paste is mixed with sugar and poured into moulds, where it sets into bars.
task1.why: 流程图全程被动；用 first / then / finally 分段，不要 and then and then 串联。
task1.src: 补充题型（你的四篇里没有）

task1.title: 地图 · 镇中心变化
task1.zh: 1990 年：北侧农田、东侧小店、南侧火车站。现在：农田变停车场，小店变超市，火车站扩建。
slots: 最显著的变化（方位 + 变化动词）
task1.ref: The most striking change is in the north, where farmland has been replaced by a car park. The small shops in the east have given way to a supermarket, and the railway station in the south has been extended.
task1.why: 地图题先给方位再给变化；变化动词用 be replaced by / give way to / be extended。
task1.src: 补充题型（你的四篇里没有）

task2.prompt: Some people believe that unpaid community service should be a compulsory part of high school programmes. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
task2.zh: 有人认为高中生必须参加无偿社区服务。你同意到什么程度？
task2.stance: 同意，但有保留：应该做，前提是学校提供支持和评估，而不是硬凑时长。

chain.claim: Compulsory service exposes teenagers to people and problems outside their own bubble.
chain.reason: Most students spend their days among peers of the same age and background.
chain.example: Working in a care home or a food bank forces them to talk to the elderly and the poor.
chain.link: This kind of exposure is hard to replicate in a classroom.

chain.claim: However, compulsion only works if schools provide structure and support.
chain.reason: Unsupervised placements easily turn into box-ticking exercises.
chain.example: A student who spends 40 hours stacking shelves learns little beyond following orders.
chain.link: Schools should therefore partner with vetted organisations and require reflection.

traps: 题目问的是 compulsory，必须回应「强制」这一层，不能只写社区服务的好处。
不要全篇举例，每个例子后面要有一句因果。
To what extent 允许有保留，不要写成绝对支持。

task2.prompt: Some people think that universities should provide graduates with the knowledge and skills needed in the workplace. Others think the true function of a university is to give access to knowledge for its own sake. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
task2.zh: 大学该教职业技能，还是该为知识而知识？讨论双方并给出你的观点。
task2.stance: 两者不对立：职业能力是底线，通识教育决定上限。

chain.claim: Workplace-oriented training is essential because most graduates need to earn a living.
chain.reason: Employers expect basic competence from day one.
chain.example: A computer science graduate who cannot write code will struggle however widely read they are.
chain.link: Universities cannot ignore this practical demand.

chain.claim: Yet a university is not a training centre; its wider function is to teach people how to think.
chain.reason: Specific skills date quickly, whereas judgement does not.
chain.example: A history graduate may forget the dates but keeps the ability to weigh evidence.
chain.link: This is why academic breadth should remain part of the curriculum.

traps: discuss both 必须两边都写、篇幅相当，只写一边直接 5 分。
结尾必须给自己的观点，不能只总结双方。
不要把 both views 写成 agree/disagree 的变体。
phrases: In my view, the two are not mutually exclusive.

task2.prompt: In some countries, more and more people choose to live by themselves. Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
task2.zh: 越来越多人选择独居。利大于弊吗？
task2.stance: 对年轻人利大于弊，对老年人相反——按人群分，别一概而论。

chain.claim: For young adults, living alone builds independence and self-management.
chain.reason: They must handle bills, cooking and schedules without parental backup.
chain.example: A 22-year-old renting a flat alone learns to budget far faster than a peer living at home.
chain.link: These habits pay off for decades.

chain.claim: For older people, however, solitude can turn into isolation.
chain.reason: Retirement removes the daily social contact that work provided.
chain.example: An elderly widower living alone may go days without speaking to anyone.
chain.link: The same housing choice carries very different risks at different ages.

traps: outweigh 要求明确比较，不能两边各写一段就收尾。
要给出判断标准（按年龄、按阶段），否则结论站不住。
不要把独居和孤独直接划等号。
phrases: The benefits are most obvious among ...

task2.prompt: In many cities, traffic congestion has become a serious problem. What are the causes of this problem and what measures could be taken to solve it?
task2.zh: 城市交通拥堵的原因与对策。
task2.stance: 根因是私家车仍是最便宜的选项；对策要让公共交通真正有竞争力。

chain.claim: The root cause is that private cars remain the cheapest and most convenient option.
chain.reason: Public transport is often slow, crowded or unavailable outside the centre.
chain.example: A commuter who needs 70 minutes by bus but 25 by car will drive.
chain.link: Congestion is a rational response to bad alternatives.

chain.claim: The most effective measure is to make public transport genuinely competitive.
chain.reason: People change behaviour when the alternative is faster, not when they are lectured.
chain.example: Cities that built dedicated bus lanes cut journey times and saw ridership rise.
chain.link: Investment must come before restrictions.

traps: 原因和措施要一一对应，原因说车多，措施就不能只写「教育公众」。
不要把原因写成「人们乱开车」，那是现象不是原因。
措施要有执行主体（政府 / 企业 / 学校）。
phrases: A further measure would be to ...

task2.prompt: In some countries, people spend large amounts of money on weddings. Why is this the case? Is it a positive or negative development?
task2.zh: 为什么人们花大钱办婚礼？这是好事还是坏事？
task2.stance: 原因是面子与比较；总体是负面发展。

chain.claim: The main reason is that weddings have become a public statement of status.
chain.reason: Social media turns a private ceremony into a performance judged by hundreds.
chain.example: Couples compare venues and guest lists with those of their friends.
chain.link: Spending is driven by comparison, not by the couple's actual needs.

chain.claim: Overall, this is a negative development.
chain.reason: The money often comes from savings or loans that could fund housing.
chain.example: A family may spend a year's income on one day and then struggle with rent.
chain.link: The pressure is financial and emotional at once.

traps: 两问都要答，第二问必须明确 positive 或 negative，不能和稀泥。
第一问要挖动机（面子、比较、家庭期待），不能只说「因为爱」。
不要把两问写成两篇小作文，要有连接。
phrases: This trend can be explained by ...
In my view, it is largely a negative development.
This is not to say that ...

task2.prompt: Some people think governments should spend more money on public transport than on roads. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
task2.zh: 政府该把更多钱花在公共交通而不是道路上。你同意吗？
task2.stance: 基本同意，但取决于城市密度。

chain.claim: In dense cities, public transport moves far more people per pound spent.
chain.reason: A metro line carries the equivalent of several motorway lanes.
chain.example: London's congestion charge reduced traffic while bus patronage rose.
chain.link: The efficiency argument is strongest where land is scarce.

chain.claim: In sparsely populated areas, roads remain the only realistic option.
chain.reason: Buses cannot run profitably where demand is thin.
chain.example: Rural patients still need roads to reach hospitals.
chain.link: Spending should therefore follow density, not dogma.

traps: 必须回应比较级 more ... than roads，不能只夸公共交通。
不要只写环保，题目问的是花钱优先级。
有保留的同意要写清楚「在什么条件下」。
phrases: The strongest case for ... is in dense cities.
This is not to say that ...
Spending should follow density, not dogma.

task2.prompt: Some people think that technology makes life more complex, while others believe it simplifies life. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
task2.zh: 科技让生活更复杂，还是更简单？
task2.stance: 两边都成立，但净效果是简化。

chain.claim: Technology adds complexity because every convenience brings a new system to maintain.
chain.reason: Accounts, updates and compatibility issues consume time.
chain.example: A single household may juggle five subscriptions and three chargers.
chain.link: The benefits are real, but so is the cognitive load.

chain.claim: Yet the same tools remove far more effort than they add.
chain.reason: Tasks that once took hours now take minutes.
chain.example: Online banking replaced a half-day queue with a two-minute transfer.
chain.link: On balance, the simplification dominates.

traps: 两个观点都要有具体例子，不能一边空转。
自己的观点要明确，不要用「取决于」收尾。
别写成科技产品清单。

task2.prompt: More and more students are choosing to study online instead of attending classes in person. Do the advantages outweigh the disadvantages?
task2.zh: 越来越多学生选择线上而非线下上课。利大于弊吗？
task2.stance: 有条件地利大于弊：结构化的线上课可以，纯放养不行。

chain.claim: Online study widens access.
chain.reason: Students can learn from anywhere, including areas with no specialist teachers.
chain.example: A student in a small town can take a course taught by a professor abroad.
chain.link: This is a genuine gain in equality of opportunity.

chain.claim: However, it weakens the discipline and feedback that classrooms provide.
chain.reason: Without fixed schedules and face-to-face contact, many students drift.
chain.example: Completion rates for unsupervised online courses are notoriously low.
chain.link: The format works best when it is structured, not when it simply replaces a lecture.

traps: 必须比较线上与线下，不能只写线上优缺点。
outweigh 要有明确结论。
不要把「方便」当唯一论据，要写清代价。
phrases: This is not without costs, however.
Whether this is a net gain depends on ...
Provided that ..., the benefits are considerable.

task2.prompt: Plastic waste has become a major environmental problem. What are the causes of this problem and what can be done about it?
task2.zh: 塑料垃圾问题的原因与对策。
task2.stance: 根因是价格信号倒挂；对策是生产者责任延伸。

chain.claim: The core cause is that plastic is cheap to produce and expensive to dispose of properly.
chain.reason: Manufacturers pay for the product, not for its afterlife.
chain.example: A bottle costs cents to make and centuries to break down.
chain.link: The price signal is therefore inverted.

chain.claim: Extended producer responsibility shifts the cost back to the producer.
chain.reason: If companies pay for collection, they design for recyclability.
chain.example: Deposit-return schemes in Norway recover over 90% of bottles.
chain.link: Regulation, not consumer guilt, drives the change.

traps: 别把原因写成「人们乱扔」，那是行为不是原因。
措施要写执行主体和机制，不要只写「提高意识」。
原因与措施要对应。

task2.prompt: More and more people are keeping pets. Why is this happening? Is it a positive or negative development?
task2.zh: 为什么越来越多人养宠物？这是好事还是坏事？
task2.stance: 原因是孤独；总体正面，前提是负责任地养。

chain.claim: People keep pets because modern life is lonelier than it looks.
chain.reason: Urbanisation separates people from extended families.
chain.example: A single professional in a small flat may talk to a dog more than to colleagues.
chain.link: Pets fill a gap that institutions cannot.

chain.claim: On balance, this is positive, provided ownership is responsible.
chain.reason: Pets improve mental health and daily routine.
chain.example: Walking a dog forces exercise and incidental social contact.
chain.link: The harm comes from neglect, not from the bond itself.

traps: 第二问要明确判断，不要通篇写宠物可爱。
原因要写社会结构（独居、城市化），不要只写「喜欢」。
正面结论要加前提，否则经不起反驳。
phrases: This trend can be explained by ...
On balance, I regard it as ...
Provided that ..., the benefits are considerable.
